solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Give about one million, returning to get control

indicators.note: about means the gift word goes around the other pieces

parts.note: to give is to donate

indicators.note: returning means the letters for one and million are read backwards

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A donor hands over about a million and comes back to take charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns I and M into MI, and 'about' puts DONATE around it.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean to have power over, synonyms as verbs.

clue.text: Cut weed

definitions.meaning: to cut short, as a tail or wages

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: trimming wages or tails, and a common plant whose leaves soothe nettle stings.

clue.text: Fellow joining soldiers in mansion

parts.note: a fellow is a man
OR is other ranks, ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: A man joins the troops in a grand house.
explanation.definitionFit: A large country house with land, a near synonym for a mansion.

clue.text: A sonnet's line badly written? It doesn't matter

indicators.note: badly written means the letters of the phrase are jumbled

explanation.surface: A poet shrugs off a poorly composed line in a sonnet.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unnecessary is a thing of no importance, which is what the phrase describes.

clue.text: Building constructions of sort we fancy

indicators.note: fancy as an adjective means elaborate, telling us the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Buildings of a kind we like.
explanation.definitionFit: Tall structures such as spires and keeps are kinds of building.

clue.text: A girl falling short unfortunately

indicators.note: falling short means the word for girl loses its final letter

parts.note: a lass is a girl

explanation.surface: A girl who doesn't quite make it, sadly.
explanation.definitionFit: The exclamation of regret serves as a synonym for sadly or unfortunately.

clue.text: Coal left to catch fire

parts.note: to ignite is to catch fire

explanation.surface: Coal is left to start burning.
explanation.definitionFit: Brown coal, a soft low-grade type of the fuel, is an example.

clue.text: A daughter interrupts calm piece of music

indicators.note: interrupts means these letters break into the word for calm

parts.note: serene means calm

explanation.surface: A daughter breaks into a peaceful tune.
explanation.walkthrough: 'interrupts' signals the insertion; 'calm' is an adjective here, not a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A song sung beneath a lover's window at evening, a kind of musical piece.

clue.text: I stopped and I collapsed, downcast

indicators.note: collapsed means the letters fall into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone who halted and then broke down, feeling low.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling let down and dejected, a synonym for being low in spirits.

clue.text: Conservative soon to become ordained minister

parts.note: anon is an old word for soon

explanation.surface: A Tory is about to be ordained into the church.
explanation.definitionFit: A cathedral clergyman holding this title is an ordained minister, a specific example.

clue.text: Mangle with bell?

parts.note: a ringer is a bell, as in a dead ringer

explanation.surface: A question about a laundry mangle fitted with a bell.
explanation.walkthrough: A mangle is an old machine of rollers for squeezing water from washing; 'bell' as RINGER is a thing that rings.
explanation.definitionFit: The old laundry device that squeezes water out through rollers goes by both names, synonyms.

clue.text: Safeguarding quiet place for Native Americans

parts.note: P is piano, the musical abbreviation for quiet
a reservation is land set aside for Native American tribes

explanation.surface: Protecting a peaceful homeland for Native Americans.
explanation.definitionFit: Keeping something safe from harm or decay is a synonym, a noun of protection.

clue.text: Cause pain somehow when dropping one kitchen item

indicators.note: somehow means the remaining letters are rearranged
when dropping means one letter is removed from the phrase

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A cook's utensil somehow hurts when it is dropped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when dropping' takes I from CAUSE PAIN; 'somehow' rearranges CAUSEPAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep cooking pot with a handle, an example of kitchen equipment.

clue.text: Bit of plant the lady's found by insect

parts.note: an ant is an insect
her is the possessive for a woman, the lady's

explanation.surface: A woman's piece of greenery has an insect on it.
explanation.definitionFit: The pollen-bearing part of a flower's stamen, so a part of a plant.

clue.text: Article with more unusual proposition

parts.note: the is the definite article

indicators.note: unusual signals the letters of more are rearranged

explanation.surface: A writer's piece offering a rather odd suggestion.
explanation.definitionFit: In mathematics a statement to be proved is a proposition; a synonym.

clue.text: Add on a couple of pages, then finish

parts.note: pp is the abbreviation for pages, two p's
to finish is to end

explanation.surface: Instructions to tack a few pages onto a document and conclude.
explanation.definitionFit: To attach something at the end of a document, a synonym for tacking on.

clue.text: Seeing, finally, row of mountains and farmstead

indicators.note: finally takes the final letter of seeing

parts.note: a range is a line of mountains

explanation.surface: Spotting at last a mountain chain and a farm.
explanation.definitionFit: A country house with farm buildings, so a farmstead by synonym.

clue.text: See one bit of farm somewhere in Derbyshire

parts.note: a see is a bishop's diocese, and Chester is one
a field is one part of a farm

explanation.surface: A tourist told to look at a corner of a farm somewhere in Derbyshire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' looks like an instruction, but it is a bishop's diocese: Chester is a cathedral city. Derbyshire is an English county.
explanation.definitionFit: A market town in Derbyshire, England, famous for its crooked church spire: a place example.

clue.text: Depart with characters from Middle Avenue

indicators.note: characters from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone sets off with people who live on Middle Avenue.
explanation.definitionFit: To go away from a place, a synonymous verb.

clue.text: Type of grass that is not straight

explanation.definitionFit: A fine lawn grass shares its name with the word for crooked or curved.

clue.text: Painter struggling to be relevant

indicators.note: struggling suggests the letters of painter are in disarray

explanation.surface: An artist battling to stay relevant.
explanation.definitionFit: To relate or apply to something, a synonym for being relevant.

clue.text: Time to have relaxation, guy!

definitions.note: used as a verb, to guy is to mock

parts.note: ease is relaxation

explanation.surface: Calling to a fellow that it's time to relax.
explanation.walkthrough: 'guy' looks like a noun addressing a man, but it is the verb meaning to make fun of.
explanation.definitionFit: To guy someone is to ridicule or poke fun at them, a synonymous verb.

clue.text: Maybe one has no hesitation becoming unfeeling

indicators.note: has no means the hesitation sound is removed

parts.note: one is an example of a number
er is a sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Someone who acts without hesitating becomes cold.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking sensation or emotional response, a synonym for unfeeling.

clue.text: Most deprived teen, after reverse, conks out inside

indicators.note: inside puts the word for conks out within the other piece
after reverse means the word teen is read backwards

parts.note: to conk out is to die, so conks out gives dies

explanation.surface: A poor teenager who goes into reverse and stalls.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after reverse' turns the teen word backwards, giving NEET; 'inside' then places the dying word within it. 'conks out' sounds like a car, but simply means dies.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative of needy, meaning poorest or most in want.
